subject: Superintendent Composite Evaluation
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed the compiled 2022–2023 evaluation for the superintendent, which rated her overall summative performance as Proficient. The committee approved an amendment to include full member comments and approved the composite evaluation.

items.title: Superintendent Composite Evaluation Review
items.summary: Member Graham presented the draft composite evaluation consolidating all school committee members' individual scores, reflecting consensus ratings of Met on annual goals and Proficient across all state performance standards.

items.title: Amendment to Evaluation Comments
items.summary: Approved a motion to amend the evaluation document to replace compressed text with Member Ruseau's complete original comments on an additional page.

items.title: Approval of Superintendent Composite Evaluation
items.summary: Approved the superintendent's composite evaluation as amended.
